title: Sunset Bash 2025: Innovation, Luxury & Connection on the Miami Waterfront
description: Sunset Bash 2025 brought the best of boating and luxury lifestyle to Miami’s Bayshore Landing. Hosted by FYI Yachts and BTE, the event featured exclusive NHD Yacht sea trials, a high-profile debut of the NHD 315, and vibrant showcases from top-tier partners — all set against the backdrop of Miami’s iconic waterfront.
html:
This past weekend, FYI Yachts and BTE hosted the much-anticipated Sunset Bash 2025 at Bayshore Landing in Miami. This exclusive boating lifestyle event brought together yacht enthusiasts, industry leaders, and luxury lifestyle connoisseurs for two unforgettable days of sea trials, networking, and waterside experiences.

Showcasing the Future of Boating: NHD Yacht Sea Trials

One of the event’s highlights was the hands-on experience aboard the latest models from NHD Yachts, including the NHD 325, NHD 355, and NHD 365. Most notably, guests witnessed the official debut of the all-new NHD 315 — a sleek, performance-forward yacht powered by twin Mercury Verado V8 300 engines.

From exhilarating sea trials to dockside conversations, attendees explored the full range of NHD’s cutting-edge design, comfort, and marine technology.

Partner Highlights: Elevating the Sunset Bash Experience

The event was elevated by our exceptional partners, each bringing a unique flavor to the Sunset Bash experience:

  • Car King – Presented a stunning collection of exotic and luxury vehicles, delivering a street-level adrenaline rush that complemented the maritime luxury.
  • Center Consoles Only (CCO) – Introduced attendees to the CCO Boat Club, offering VIP access to high-end boats and premier lifestyle events.
  • DS18 – Energized the event with high-performance marine audio systems, featuring a custom Jeep demo rig that made waves with its sound and style.
  • Quick USA Store – Showcased premium marine accessories, highlighting their commitment to performance, innovation, and quality craftsmanship.

We’re grateful to collaborate with brands who share our passion for excellence on the water.

Thank You for an Unforgettable Weekend

To everyone who joined us at Sunset Bash 2025 — thank you. Your presence helped make the weekend a true celebration of innovation, community, and the marine lifestyle.

This is just the beginning. Stay connected for updates on future events, sea trials, and exclusive experiences from FYI Yachts and BTE.
